title: CULTURAL ALIGNMENT IN LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS: AN EXPLANATORY ANALYSIS BASED ON HOFSTEDE’S CULTURAL DIMENSIONS

bias_targets.methodology: Quantifying cultural alignment by administering Hofstede's Value Survey Model 2013 (VSM13) questionnaire to LLMs using country-specific personas, and calculating Kendall Tau correlation coefficients between the models' generated cultural dimension rankings and real-world empirical data for the US, China, and Arab countries.

Comparing the cultural dimension scores of LLMs when prompted in different languages (English, Chinese, Arabic) and evaluating models fine-tuned on specific instruction languages (e.g., Llama 2 English vs. Chinese) to observe shifts in embedded cultural values.
